title: What Time Do You…?
subtitle: Saying when things happen
review: Written by Claude, modelled on the French fundamentals. Check the IPA (British) and any Burmese before using it with learners. No audio yet: record with `audio.py words`.

words.fr: What time do you get up?
When do you go to bed?

groups.title: At, about, from, to
notes: Use at before a time: at seven o'clock, at half past eight.

words.fr: I get up at six o'clock.
I go home at half past three.
I go to bed at nine o'clock.
